title: WinClean rules document
description: Schema for WinClean's rules.json. Cleanable targets are fully data-driven: adding a new target requires only a JSON edit.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier used by settings and history.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the review screen.

category.description: Grouping for the category tree, e.g. 'System' or 'Browsers'.

description.description: Plain-language explanation shown to the user before anything is deleted.

riskLevel.description: Drives the risk badge shown in the review screen.

requiresAdmin.description: True when the rule's roots typically require elevation (e.g. under %WINDIR%).

paths.description: Root folders to scan. Environment variables (%TEMP%) are expanded by the loader. A '*' segment matches any single directory name and is expanded at scan time.

filePattern.description: File name pattern, e.g. '*.tmp'. Must not contain path separators. Defaults to '*'.

recursive.description: Also match files in subfolders of each root.

specialTarget.description: Built-in special handler. 'RecycleBin' empties the Recycle Bin via the Windows Shell API, never by manual deletion of the bin's on-disk folders.
